args.subject: Studio open house — final headcount
args.body:
Hi Joy,

The final headcount from the yes RSVPs I could confirm is 11 people, including guests: Lucia + partner (2), Jonas (1), Priya + two colleagues (3), Ben (1), Tomas (1), and Greta + one (2).

I couldn't confirm the 7 older messages because they weren't included in the message results I could access, so this count may not include those responses. Noor said “maybe” and is not counted. Please treat 11 as the confirmed count from the messages available to me, not a fully verified total.

Best,
Ori
